title: Group a few values
summary: Erlang: Group a few values. Change the number to 6.
introduction: A tuple can hold a status and a result. Pattern matching pulls its parts into names.
learningObjectives: Group a few values with Erlang

blocks.text: Save each example as lesson.erl. Run erlc lesson.erl, then erl -noshell -s lesson main -s init stop. The file name must match the module name.
The tuple pattern matches ok and binds Score to 8.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The tuple shape and first atom must match.
